Game Overview

Jake Black Cat is a adventure game built around leap into the paws of Jake, the fearless cat, in a vibrant adventure filled with peril and feline foes. Navigate treacherous terrains with skillful double jumps, collect prized cat food, and outmaneuver enemies over eight thrilling levels to safely return home. Can you master the challenge?
